selection_method: Curated recent coverage for market-movement candidates from the 2026-10-15 S&P 500 market snapshot; publication times were cross-checked against publisher pages or Google News RSS.
notes: CONTENT fields are original factual summaries, not copied article text.
IS_HEADLINE is unknown because homepage placement was not independently verified.
Investing.com display times were recorded with the regional timezone shown by the accessed edition.
SKYD was not assigned Skyward Specialty coverage because public results identified that company as SKWD; the ticker mapping needs verification before ingestion of related news.
This is a focused prototype sample, not complete coverage of all 500 market-data tickers.
